bio: Chef Xavier Rambaud, a real globetrotter, travelled quite a bit before dropping anchor here. The dining area is done out in an industrial bistro style (parquet flooring, wooden tables, exposed stonework and cast-iron pipes). The chef concocts multi-layered creative cuisine, such as stingray wing, rice and black garlic; scallops, asparagus and rhubarb; or pork belly, carrot and apple: well-rounded dishes replete with winning flavour combinations....
